backend.envVarValue: bare host only, e.g. http://172.16.0.12 (no path) — shared with DOMAIN_CONFIGURATION
backend.responseEnvelope: { success: boolean, message: string, data: object|null }
backend.authHeadersActuallySent: Authorization: Bearer <token> AND Cookie: access_token=<token> — injected globally by src/proxy.js + src/app/api/_lib/proxy.js, never per-route (CLAUDE.md API rule 3). This domain's Swagger is the one that confirmed the cookie scheme live (GET /p0/cdm/configRouter/plants declares access_token as string (cookie)).

plantField.name: plant_code_id
plantField.note: Query param on GET/DELETE per CLAUDE.md Rule 0. Never a custom X-PlantCodeId header.

notes: Trailing slash matters: the backend 404s on GET .../configRouter/plants/ (verified live), which is why the list route's path is the literal '/plants' leaf and BACKEND_PATHS carries everything up to /configRouter — buildUrl() always renders path '/' as a trailing slash.
Backend path segment for the preview endpoint is camelCase 'purgePreview'; the local client route is kebab-case 'purge-preview' (same casing split as sapTables/userConfig elsewhere in CDM config).

This registry deliberately does NOT share the DOMAIN_CONFIGURATION/CDM next.config.js rewrite plumbing — whether those rewrites also need the /api/decisionops-pod1 gateway prefix is still an open question, intentionally untouched.

components: src/components/admin/views/DeletePlantModal.jsx (deletePlantId, getPurgePreview — purge-impact preview shown when the cascade toggle is enabled, wired 2026-07-13)

endpoints.name: getPlantIds
endpoints.description: List all registered plants. Returns an array of plant records.
openIssues: Doc (2026-07-13 table) marks plant_code_id as a REQUIRED query param, but this endpoint feeds the plant selector BEFORE any plant is chosen (chicken-and-egg) and the current param-less call is verified working live. User decision 2026-07-13: skip — do not change this call until the backend team clarifies what value the param should carry on first load.

endpoints.name: createPlantId
endpoints.description: Create a new plant (admin only). Validates plant_code_id, label, and industry.

requestBody.label: string (optional, defaults to plant_code_id client-side)
requestBody.industry: string (optional per doc; UI requires a backend industry enum, e.g. oil_gas, cement)

endpoints.name: deletePlantId
endpoints.description: Delete a plant (admin only). If cascade=true and confirm matches the plant code, a full purge is performed. Backend 409s on plain delete while CDM data still references the plant.

requestParams.confirm: string, must equal plantCode (optional, required for purge)

endpoints.name: getPurgePreview
endpoints.description: Preview cascade-purge impact for a plant (admin only). Returns counts per storage layer.
endpoints.notes: Service returns the unwrapped data object. DeletePlantModal renders every numeric field dynamically (known labels for postgres_rows/iotdb_series/rustfs_objects, prettified fallback for new keys), so additive backend fields need no frontend change.
